cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Exactly as Planned
cards.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Mum found the surprise-party invitations. Right on schedule. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made me hide them in my sock drawer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. She had to feel she'd uncovered it herself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's cancelling the caterer. She hates surprises.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's her part of the plan: taking control. We surprise her with how completely we obey.
